title: Debating Ethical Dilemmas / Majadiliano ya Matatizo ya Kiuthamini
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, ili kujadili tunatumia kipima cha halli baada ya maneno ya maoni. Katika Kiingereza, kipima hiki ni kamwezi zaidi; inapendelea kipima cha halli au makusanyiko ya kimodas. Kwa mfano, 'sinaamini kwamba ni sawasawa' inasemwa 'I don't think it is right' (si 'it be right'). Pia, kutumia 'should' na 'would' kwa mashauri na mifano hayana mfano wa kina katika Kihispania, ambapo tunatumia kipima cha halli. Angalia nafasi ya maneno ya kuwashirikisha na ukosefu wa ukubwa wa upungufu katika Kiingereza.
rule: Ili kujadili katika Kiingereza kwa ngazi ya B2, tumia: 1) 'I think/ believe/ feel' + kipima cha halli: 'I think that...' (si kipima cha halli). 2) Maneno ya kimodas: 'should' (mashauri), 'ought to' (rasmi), 'must' (majukumu makubwa), 'can't' (ukosefu wa uwezo), 'could' (uwezo), 'would' (mifano). 3) Makusanyiko ya kuwafikia/kushtaki: 'I agree with... because...', 'I see your point, but...', 'That may be true, however...'. 4) Mifano ya kuwafikia kwa ajili ya mifano ya kiuthamini: 'If we allowed... , then...' (kipima cha kwanza), 'If I were in that situation, I would...' (kipima cha pili). 5) Maneno ya kuwashirikisha: 'therefore', 'moreover', 'nevertheless', 'although'. Epuka ukubwa wa upungufu ('I don't agree with nothing' ni batili) na tumia mabadiliko kwa kuwashirikisha: 'Not only is it unethical, but also...'.

concept_examples.text: I believe that animal testing is unethical because it causes unnecessary suffering.
concept_examples.translation: Ninasadiki kwamba majaribio ya wanyama ni isiyo na haki kwa sababu inaleta maumivu isiyofaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈænɪməl ˈtestɪŋ ɪz ʌnˈeθɪkəl bɪˈkɔːz ɪt ˈkɔːzɪz ʌnˈnesəseri ˈsʌfərɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: If I were in that situation, I would tell the truth, even if it was difficult.
concept_examples.translation: Ikiwa ningekuwa katika nyakati hiyo, ningasema kweli, hata ikawa ngumu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ɪn ðæt ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən, aɪ wʊd tɛl ðə truːθ, ˈiːvən ɪf ɪt wʌz ˈdɪfɪkəlt/

concept_examples.text: Some people argue that genetically modified crops are necessary to feed the world, but others disagree.
concept_examples.translation: Watu fulani hujaribu kwamba mimea iliyobadilishwa ya kijeni ni lazima ili kuwalisha dunia, lakini wengine hawafiki.
concept_examples.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt dʒəˈnetɪkli ˈmɒdɪfaɪd krɒps ɑːr ˈnesəseri tuː fiːd ðə wɜːrld, bʌt ˈʌðərz ˌdɪsəˈɡriː/

concept_examples.text: We shouldn't sacrifice privacy for security; both are essential.
concept_examples.translation: Hatupaswi kufanya fedha za usalama kwa ajili ya usalama; mawili ni muhimu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈʃʊdnt ˈsækrɪfaɪs ˈpraɪvəsi fɔːr sɪˈkjʊrəti; boʊθ ɑːr ɪˈsenʃəl/

common_error.wrong: I don't think that it is not ethical to lie.
common_error.correct: I don't think it is ethical to lie.
common_error.correct_alt: I think it is unethical to lie.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu hii hutokea kwa sababu katika Kihispania ni kawaida kuwepo kwa upungufu mwadilifu ('Sinaamini kwamba si sawasawa'), lakini katika Kiingereza jumla moja tu inaweza kuwa na upungufu mmoja. Ili kuweka kwenye kwenye, ondoa 'not' au badilisha na neno la kinyume (isiyo na haki).

examples.original: In my opinion, we should recycle more.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, wiː ʃʊd ˌriːˈsaɪkəl mɔːr/
examples.translation: Katika maoni yangu, tunapaswa kufanya tena zaidi.
examples.note: Tumia 'katika maoni yangu' mwanzo ili kuwashirikisha maoni yako.

examples.original: I strongly believe that every child deserves a quality education.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈɛvri tʃaɪld dɪˈzɜːrvz ə ˈkwɒləti ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Ninasadiki kwa nguvu kwamba kila mtoto anastahili elimu ya kilimo.
examples.note: Neno la kuwashirikisha 'kwa nguvu' inatoka kabla ya neno la msingi 'sadiki'.

examples.original: From my perspective, this policy has more benefits than drawbacks.
examples.phonetic: /frɒm maɪ pərˈspɛktɪv, ðɪs ˈpɒləsi hæz mɔːr ˈbɛnɪfɪts ðæn ˈdrɔːbæks/
examples.translation: Kutoka kwenye mwangaza wangu, sera hii ina faida zaidi kuliko hasara.
examples.note: Epuka kutafsiri kwa kina 'Kutoka kwenye mwangaza wangu'.

examples.original: I couldn't agree more with your argument about renewable energy.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkʊdnt əˈɡriː mɔːr wɪð jɔːr ˈɑːrɡjumənt əˈbaʊt rɪˈnjuːəbl ˈɛnərdʒi/
examples.translation: Sina uwezo wa kufikia zaidi na juhudi lako kuhusu nishati inayotengenezwa tena.
examples.note: Ujumbe huu maana kufikia kwa kamilifu. Usimfanye na 'Sina uwezo wa kufikia' (sina uwezo wa kufikia).

examples.original: I see your point, but I think there are other factors to consider.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː jɔːr pɔɪnt, bʌt aɪ θɪŋk ðeər ɑːr ˈʌðər ˈfæktərz tuː kənˈsɪdər/
examples.translation: Nafahamu mwangaza wako, lakini ninasadiki kwamba kuna sehemu nyingine za kufikiri.
examples.note: Njia ya kushiriki kwa kiwango cha kutosha bila kushangaza.

examples.original: That may be true, however, we must also think about the long-term effects.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt meɪ biː truː, haʊˈɛvər, wiː mʌst ˈɔːlsoʊ θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈlɔːŋtɜːrm ɪˈfɛkts/
examples.translation: Hiyo inaweza kuwa kweli, lakini, tunapaswa kufikiri kuhusu matokeo ya muda mrefu.
examples.note: Kutumia 'lakini' baada ya msingi wa koma.

examples.original: If the government banned all private cars, the air quality would improve significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt bænd ɔːl ˈpraɪvɪt kɑːrz, ðiː ɛər ˈkwɒləti wʊd ɪmˈpruːv sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Ikiwa serikali ingelilinda magari yote ya kibinadamu, ubora wa hewa ungeongezeka kwa kiwango kikubwa.
examples.note: Kipima cha pili kwa ajili ya nyakati isiyokweli au ya kuwafikia. Katika Kiingereza, tumia 'were' badala ya 'was' kwa ajili ya vitu vyote katika kipima cha kuwafikia.

examples.original: If I were the CEO, I would prioritize employee well-being over profits.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ðə ˌsiː.iːˈoʊ, aɪ wʊd praɪˈɔːrɪtaɪz ˌɛmplɔɪˈiː ˌwɛlˈbiːɪŋ ˈoʊvər ˈprɒfɪts/
examples.translation: Ikiwa ningekuwa mdiri wa kwanza, ningeweka afya ya wafanyakazi kabla ya fedha.
examples.note: Kutumia kwenye kwenye 'were' katika kipima cha halli cha zamani. Watu wengi wa Kihispania wanatenda kusema 'I was'.

examples.original: What would you do if you found a wallet with a thousand dollars inside?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd juː duː ɪf juː faʊnd ə ˈwɔːlɪt wɪð ə ˈθaʊzənd ˈdɒlərz ɪnˈsaɪd?/
examples.translation: Ungafanya nini ukiweka fedha za elfu moja ndani ya mkoba?
examples.note: Umbali wa swali katika kipima cha kuwafikia: msahili 'would' mwanzo.

examples.original: If we don't act now, future generations will suffer the consequences.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt ækt naʊ, ˈfjuːtʃər ˌdʒɛnəˈreɪʃənz wɪl ˈsʌfər ðə ˈkɒnsɪkwɛnsɪz/
examples.translation: Ikiwa hatutafanya sasa, vizazi vijavyo vitakabiliwa na matokeo.
examples.note: Kipima cha kwanza kwa ajili ya nyakati za kweli na za kuwafikia.

title: Strategic Language for Negotiations / Lugha ya Kimataifa kwa Majaribio
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, mara nyingi hutumia vifaa kama vile 'would', 'could' na 'might' ili kutoa hisia za kushangaza ('I would like', 'I’d prefer'), wakati wa Kiswahili tunatumia mifumo tofauti kama vile 'ningetaka' au 'ningependa'. Pia, washirika wa Kiingereza wanakabiliwa kutoa jibu la 'hapana' kwa ubora zaidi kwa kutumia maneno kama vile 'I'm afraid' au 'unfortunately', wakati wa Kiswahili tunakabiliwa kutoa jibu la 'hapana' kwa ubora zaidi kwa kutumia maneno kama vile 'samahani' au 'sijui'. Hifadhi kuwa 'de acuerdo' haifanyiwe utaratibu kama 'I am agree' - fiili inayofaa ni 'agree' bila ya msaada.
rule: Katika majaribio ya Kiingereza kwa ngazi ya B2, hutumia vifaa kama vile 'would', 'could', 'might', na 'may' ili kutoa hisia za kushangaza na mifumo (I would suggest..., We could consider...). Mifumo kama vile 'I want...' au 'You must...' hayana ubora wa kutosha. Ili kutoa mapendekezo, hutumia 'What if...' au 'How about...' inayofuata na kufanya kazi. Ili kutoa ubinafsi kwa ubora, hutumia maneno kama vile 'I see your point, but...' au 'I'm afraid that...'. Wakati wa kufanya majaribio ya masharti, hutumia mifumo ya kusharti (If... then...). Kumbuka kwamba katika Kiingereza, 'agree' ni fiili, si sifa, kwa hiyo hutuseme 'I am agree' bali 'I agree'.

concept_examples.text: I would suggest we postpone the deadline to next week.
concept_examples.translation: Ningependa kupendekeza kwamba tutunde taarifa ya mwisho hadi wiki ijayo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd səˈdʒɛst wi poʊstˈpoʊn ðə ˈdɛdlaɪn tu nɛkst wik/

concept_examples.text: We could consider a discount if you increase the order volume.
concept_examples.translation: Tunaweza kufikiri kuhusu chombo kidogo ikiwa mtaongeza ukiwa wa ombi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wi kʊd kənˈsɪdər ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɪf ju ˈɪnkris ðə ˈɔrdər ˈvɑljum/

concept_examples.text: I'm afraid that price is a bit higher than we expected.
concept_examples.translation: Nina hofu kwamba bei hiyo ni chache zaidi ya kuliko tulikuwa na matumaini.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæt praɪs ɪz ə bɪt ˈhaɪər ðæn wi ɪkˈspɛktɪd/

concept_examples.text: What if we split the difference and meet in the middle?
concept_examples.translation: Je, unadhani tutakapoweka tofauti na kutana katikati?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi splɪt ðə ˈdɪfərəns ænd mit ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct: I agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct_alt: I completely agree with your proposal, but we would need a better price.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu hii hutokea kwa sababu katika Kiswahili tusema 'nina ufanisi' (kutumia fiili 'kuwa na' + sifa), na kufanyiwa utaratibu hadi Kiingereza kama 'I am agree'. Katika Kiingereza, 'agree' ni fiili nzuri, si sifa, kwa hiyo haifanyiwe na 'to be'. Ili kuhifadhi hitilafu hii, kumbuka kwamba 'agree' hufanya kazi kama 'kufanana' au 'kuwa na ufanisi' lakini bila ya msaada 'be'. Pia ni kawaida kutumia maneno kama vile 'kabisa' au 'sehemu' ili kutoa ubora.

examples.original: I would like to propose a different approach.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə prəˈpoʊz ə ˈdɪfərənt əˈproʊtʃ/
examples.translation: Ningetaka kutoa mwangaza tofauti.
examples.note: Tutumia 'would like to' ili kutoa ubora na kushangaza, inavyofanana na 'ningetaka' katika Kiswahili lakini bila ya kushangaza.

examples.original: How about meeting next Tuesday?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt ˈmitɪŋ nɛkst ˈtuzdeɪ/
examples.translation: Je, unadhani tutakapokutana Jumatatu ijayo?
examples.note: 'How about' inayofuata na kufanya kazi ni mfano wa kushangaza wa kutoa mapendekezo. Haifanyiwe utaratibu.

examples.original: I suggest we revisit the terms of the contract.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ səˈdʒɛst wi riˈvɪzɪt ðə tɜrmz əv ðə ˈkɑntrækt/
examples.translation: Ninapendekeza kwamba tuchunguze masharti ya makubaliano.
examples.note: Katika Kiingereza, baada ya 'suggest' hutumia kushangaza cha msingi (bila 's' katika wa tatu), inavyofanana na kushangaza cha Kiswahili.

examples.original: I see your point, but I have some concerns about the timeline.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ si jʊr pɔɪnt bʌt aɪ hæv sʌm kənˈsɜrnz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtaɪmlaɪn/
examples.translation: Ninaelewa jambo lako, lakini nina wasiwasi baadhi kuhusu mfumo wa muda.
examples.note: Mfumo huu huongezwa ubinafsi kwa kuelewa jambo la mwingine kwanza.

examples.original: I'm afraid that's not quite what we had in mind.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæts nɑt kwaɪt wʌt wi hæd ɪn maɪnd/
examples.translation: Nina hofu kwamba si ndivyo tulikuwa na fikra.
examples.note: 'I'm afraid' haionyeshi hofu bali kutoa jibu la 'hapana' kwa ubora. Ni mfano mzuri wa kushangaza.

examples.original: I understand your position, but we would need more flexibility.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd jʊr pəˈzɪʃən bʌt wi wʊd nid mɔr ˌflɛksəˈbɪlɪti/
examples.translation: Ninaelewa nafasi yako, lakini tunahitaji ufanisi zaidi.
examples.note: Tutumia 'would need' badala ya 'need' ili kuwa na ubora zaidi na kutoa sharti zaidi.

levels.label: Negotiating Terms and Closing Deals
levels.translation: Kufanya majaribio ya masharti na kufunga makubaliano

examples.original: If you can offer a 10% discount, we would be willing to sign today.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju kæn ˈɔfər ə tɛn pɜrˈsɛnt ˈdɪskaʊnt wi wʊd bi ˈwɪlɪŋ tə saɪn təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: Ikiwa mwapata chombo cha 10%, tungekubali kuweka leo.
examples.note: Sharti na 'if' + 'would' ili kutoa sharti ya kubali.

examples.original: Let's meet halfway on the shipping costs.
examples.phonetic: /lɛts mit ˈhæfweɪ ɒn ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ kɔsts/
examples.translation: Tutakapoweka tofauti katika gharama za kutuma.
examples.note: 'Meet halfway' ni mfano wa kushangaza wa kufikia makubaliano ya katikati.

examples.original: We have a deal if you agree to these terms.
examples.phonetic: /wi hæv ə dil ɪf ju əˈgri tə ðiz tɜrmz/
examples.translation: Tuna makubaliano ikiwa mtakubali masharti haya.
examples.note: Hutumia 'a deal' badala ya 'an agreement' katika mazingira ya kushangaza ya majaribio.

title: Discussing Literature and Film / Kuzungumza kuhusu Uandishi na Filamu
bridge: Kiingereza, kuelezea maoni kuhusu vitabu na filamu, hutumika mifumo kama 'I found it...' au 'It struck me as...', ambayo hana mfanuo tofauti kwa Kiswahili, ambapo tunatumia 'niliona' au 'nilikuta'. Pia, vituo vya maoni kiingereza huwa huvinjari kabla ya jina (a gripping novel), wakati wa Kiswahili huenda baada ya jina (kitabu cha kushangaza). Tofa tofauti nyingine ni kutumia muda wa kisemi katika kuweka hadithi: Kiingereza hutumia muda wa kisemi wa sasa kuwakilisha hadithi (the protagonist discovers...), lakini Kiswahili ni kawaida muda wa sasa au muda wa zamani.
rule: Kuzungumza kuhusu uandishi na filamu kiingereza kwenye ngazi ya B2, unahitaji kufahamu: 1) Kuonyesha maoni kwa kutumia vituo na mifumo kama 'I found it + vitendo' (I found it kini) au 'It struck me as + vitendo' (It struck me as inayotajwa). 2) Kufafanua hadithi katika muda wa kisemi wa sasa (The story follows a detective who uncovers a conspiracy). 3) Kutumia muda wa zamani wa kisemi kwa matukio ya asili ulipoelezea uzoefu wako (I read the book mwaka uliopita). 4) Kulinganisha mabadiliko kwa kutumia 'unlike' au 'whereas' (Unlike the book, the film hutoa sehemu nyingi za maana). Pia ni jambo la maana kutumia 'based on' (The movie imeundwa kwa msingi wa kitabu). Katika ujumbe, vituo kama 'gripping', 'thought-provoking', 'predictable', 'far-fetched', 'moving' ni ya maana. Iepuka kufafanua 'niliona' kama 'it seemed to me' katika kila kesi; tumia 'I thought' au 'I found'.

concept_examples.text: I found the novel gripping from the first page.
concept_examples.translation: Nilikuta kitabu hiki kina kushangaza tangu ukurasa wa kwanza.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ðə ˈnɒvəl ˈɡrɪpɪŋ frəm ðə fɜːst peɪdʒ.

concept_examples.text: The film is based on a true story.
concept_examples.translation: Filamu hii imeundwa kwa msingi wa hadithi ya kweli.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə fɪlm ɪz beɪst ɒn ə truː ˈstɔːri.

concept_examples.text: Unlike the book, the movie has a much faster pace.
concept_examples.translation: Kilinganifu na kitabu, filamu ina kasi zaidi.
concept_examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ðə bʊk, ðə ˈmuːvi hæz ə mʌtʃ ˈfɑːstə peɪs.

concept_examples.text: The author uses symbolism to explore themes of identity.
concept_examples.translation: Mwandishi hutumia ishara kuelezea mada kuhusu utambulisho.
concept_examples.phonetic: ði ˈɔːθə juːzɪz ˈsɪmbəlɪzəm tuː ɪkˈsplɔː θiːmz ɒv aɪˈdentɪti.

common_error.wrong: The book is more interesting that the movie.
common_error.correct: The book is more interesting than the movie.
common_error.correct_alt: The book is more interesting compared to the movie.
common_error.explanation: Kiingereza, kulinganisha hutumika 'than' na si 'that'. Waswahili wengi huchanganya 'that' (ambayo, ya kusambaza) na 'than' (ambayo, ya kulinganisha). Kumbuka: ukilinganisha jambo mbili, tumia 'than' daima.

examples.original: I found the ending a bit predictable.
examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ði ˈendɪŋ ə bɪt prɪˈdɪktəbəl.
examples.translation: Niliona mwisho kama inayotajwa kidogo.
examples.note: Tunatumia 'I found + kitu + vitendo' kuelezea maoni. Ni asili zaidi kuliko 'I think it was'.

examples.original: It struck me as a very thought-provoking film.
examples.phonetic: ɪt strʌk mi æz ə ˈveri ˈθɔːt prəˈvəʊkɪŋ fɪlm.
examples.translation: Niliona filamu hii kama inayochangia sana.
examples.note: 'It struck me as' ni msemo wa kiswahili wa kuelezea maoni ya kibinafsi.

examples.original: The dialogue felt really natural.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈdaɪəlɒɡ fɛlt ˈrɪəli ˈnætʃrəl.
examples.translation: Mazungumzo niliona kama ya asili sana.
examples.note: Hutumiwa 'feel' kuelezea uzoefu wa kibinafsi.

examples.original: The story follows a young detective who uncovers a conspiracy.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstɔːri ˈfɒləʊz ə jʌŋ dɪˈtɛktɪv huː ʌnˈkʌvəz ə kənˈspɪrəsi.
examples.translation: Hadithi hii inaelezea kuhusu msafiri mmoja wa kijani anayekuta ufunguo.
examples.note: Tumia muda wa kisemi wa sasa kufafanua hadithi, hata kama hadithi iko zamani.

examples.original: In the end, the protagonist realizes the truth.
examples.phonetic: ɪn ði end, ðə prəˈtæɡənɪst ˈrɪəlaɪzɪz ðə truːθ.
examples.translation: Mwishowe, mwanzozi anajua kweli.
examples.note: Hutumiwa 'in the end' na si 'at the end' kuelezea mwisho wa hadithi.

examples.original: The plot twists unexpectedly when the villain is revealed.
examples.phonetic: ðə plɒt twɪsts ʌnɪkˈspɛktɪdli wɛn ðə ˈvɪlən ɪz rɪˈviːld.
examples.translation: Hadithi inaongezeka kwa kushangaza wakati uovu unapoonyeshwa.
examples.note: Muda wa kisemi wa sasa ni nzuri kuelezea mabadiliko ya hadithi.

examples.original: Whereas the book is very descriptive, the film relies on visual storytelling.
examples.phonetic: ˌweərˈæz ðə bʊk ɪz ˈveri dɪˈskrɪptɪv, ðə fɪlm rɪˈlaɪz ɒn ˈvɪʒuəl ˈstɔːritəlɪŋ.
examples.translation: Kilinganifu na kitabu, filamu inatumia maelezo ya kiufundi.
examples.note: Tumia 'whereas' kutofautisha mawazo ya mbili. Kiswahili ni 'kilinganifu na'.

examples.original: The movie adaptation leaves out a lot of the subplots.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈmuːvi ˌædæpˈteɪʃən liːvz aʊt ə lɒt ɒv ðə ˈsʌbplɒts.
examples.translation: Mabadiliko ya filamu huacha sehemu nyingi za hadithi.
examples.note: 'Leave out' maana ya kutoa. Ni kawaida katika maelezo ya mabadiliko.

examples.original: Unlike the original, the remake has a more optimistic ending.
examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ði əˈrɪdʒɪnəl, ðə ˈriːmeɪk hæz ə mɔːr ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk ˈendɪŋ.
examples.translation: Kilinganifu na asili, mabadiliko una mwisho wa furaha zaidi.
examples.note: Tumia 'unlike' mwanzo wa juma la kulinganisha.

title: Discussing Health and Science News / Kuzungumza habari za afya na sayansi
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, ni kawaida kutumia kipindi cha halli cha sasa kuhusu utafiti au habari za matibabu, wakati wa Kiswahili ni zaidi ya kawaida kutumia kipindi cha halli cha sasa kuwasiliana na wakati uliopita na wa sasa ('Watafiti wamegundua...') au kipindi cha halli cha uliopita kwa matukio ya kweli ('Utafiti ulionyesha...'). Pia, katika Kiingereza mara nyingi hutumika vitendo kama vile 'may', 'might' au 'could' kushoweka uwezo na uwasii, wakati wa Kiswahili tunakumbuka kutumia 'inaweza' au mifano isiyo na kina. Togolelo lingine ni kutumia 'however' na 'although' kushikamana, ambayo katika Kiswahili hutafsiriwa kama 'lakini' na 'ingawa', lakini na tofauti za utaratibu na sehemu katika jina.
rule: Kuzungumza mada ya sayansi na matibabu katika Kiingereza kwa ngazi ya B2, unapaswa kufahamu mambo ifuatayo: 1) Kipindi cha halli cha sasa cha kamilifu kuhusu matokeo ya karibuni na uhusiano na sasa: 'Watafiti wamegundua taa jipya' (Wamegundua...), vs. kipindi cha halli cha uliopita kwa matukio yaliyokamilika: 'Utafiti ulichapishwa mwaka 2020'. 2) Sauti isiyo na kina kuweka mshika wa kufanya kazi au matukio, si mtu anayefanya kazi: 'Dawa inaongezwa uzoefu' (Dawa inaongezwa uzoefu). 3) Vitendo vya uwezo: 'may', 'might', 'could' kushoweka wasiwasi: 'Hii inaweza kuleta matibabu mapya' (Hii inaweza kuleta matibabu mapya). 4) Vishikamanu vya tofauti: 'however' (lakini), 'although' (ingawa), 'despite' (kwa kushindana na), na utaratibu wa kweli (ingawa + jina + kipindi, au despite + jina/-ing). 5) Lugha ya kiakademiki na ya matibabu: 'uthibitishaji', 'matokeo', 'dalili', 'matibabu', 'inafa' vs. 'inafa'. Kumbuka kwamba katika Kiingereza hutengenezwa upya kutumia majina ya kina: 'Mwavaji ambaye daktari alimwonyesha...' (Mwavaji ambaye daktari alimwonyesha...). Jaribu kuelewa namba na asili, ambazo ni kawaida katika mazingira haya.

concept_examples.text: The study shows that regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
concept_examples.translation: Utafiti huonyesha kwamba mazoezi ya kawaida inaweza kupunguza hatari ya ugonjwa wa moyo.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstʌdi ʃoʊz ðæt ˈrɛɡjələr ˈɛksərˌsaɪz kæn rɪˈdus ðə rɪsk əv hɑrt dɪˈziz.

concept_examples.text: Scientists have developed a new drug that might slow down the progression of Alzheimer's.
concept_examples.translation: Watafiti wameundwa dawa jipya inayoweza kuweka mwishowe upotevu wa Alzheimer.
concept_examples.phonetic: ˈsaɪəntɪsts hæv dɪˈvɛləpt ə nu drʌg ðæt maɪt sloʊ daʊn ðə prəˈɡrɛʃən əv ˈæltsˌhaɪmərz.

concept_examples.text: Although the results are promising, many experts remain cautious.
concept_examples.translation: Ingawa matokeo ni yenye kutegemea, wataalam wengi wanabaki wenye wasiwasi.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɔːlˈðoʊ ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑr ˈprɑmɪsɪŋ ˈmɛni ˈɛkspɜrts rɪˈmeɪn ˈkɔʃəs.

concept_examples.text: The vaccine was tested on thousands of volunteers before being approved.
concept_examples.translation: Taa liliongézwa uzoefu kwenye watu wengi kabla ya kuhusishwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə vækˈsin wʌz ˈtɛstɪd ɑn ˈθaʊzəndz əv ˌvɑlənˈtɪrz bɪˈfɔr ˈbiɪŋ əˈpruvd.

common_error.wrong: Scientists has discovered a new cure for cancer.
common_error.correct: Scientists have discovered a new cure for cancer.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu hii hutokea kwa sababu katika Kiswahili hatutofautisha kati ya kipindi cha mmoja na wengi katika kusambaza kipindi 'kuwa', lakini katika Kiingereza 'have' hutumika na vituo vya wengi ('watafiti') na 'has' na vituo vya mmoja. Ili kuiweka upya, tafuta jina na iwapo ni wengi, tumia 'have'. Pia, kumbuka kwamba 'has' hutumika na mtu wa tatu mmoja (he/she/it).

examples.original: A recent study has shown that sleep deprivation affects cognitive function.
examples.phonetic: ə ˈrisənt ˈstʌdi hæz ʃoʊn ðæt slip ˌdɛprɪˈveɪʃən əˈfɛkts ˈkɑɡnɪtɪv ˈfʌŋkʃən.
examples.translation: Utafiti wa karibuni umeonyesha kwamba ukosefu wa usingizi huharibu uwezo wa kufikiri.
examples.note: Kutumia kipindi cha halli cha sasa cha kamilifu ('has shown') kuwasiliana na matokeo ya karibuni na sasa.

examples.original: Doctors recommend a balanced diet to prevent chronic diseases.
examples.phonetic: ˈdɑktərz ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ə ˈbælənst ˈdaɪət tu prɪˈvɛnt ˈkrɑnɪk dɪˈzizəz.
examples.translation: Vaidimu huheshimu chakula chetu kutoa ugonjwa wa kimwili.
examples.note: Kipindi cha kuheshimu ('recommend') + jina; katika Kiswahili tunatumia 'huheshimu' na kituo cha kina.

examples.original: The hospital has implemented new protocols to reduce infection rates.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl hæz ˈɪmpləˌmɛntɪd nu ˈproʊtəˌkɔlz tu rɪˈdus ɪnˈfɛkʃən reɪts.
examples.translation: Hospitale imeingia mikakati mapya kuweka asili za ugonjwa.
examples.note: Kipindi cha halli cha sasa cha kamilifu + 'to' + kipindi cha kuanza cha kusudi, inavyoelekeza 'kutoa + kipindi' katika Kiswahili.

examples.original: According to the latest research, there is considerable evidence that climate change affects public health.
examples.phonetic: əˈkɔrdɪŋ tu ðə ˈleɪtəst rɪˈsɜrtʃ, ðɛr ɪz kənˈsɪdərəbəl ˈɛvɪdəns ðæt ˈklaɪmət ʧeɪndʒ əˈfɛkts ˈpʌblɪk hɛlθ.
examples.translation: Kulingana na utafiti wa mwishowe, kuna uthibitishaji mkubwa kwamba mabadiliko ya hewa huharibu afya ya umma.
examples.note: Jina la 'according to' (kulingana na) + utaratibu 'there is' kwa ajili ya kuwepo.

examples.original: The findings suggest that a new treatment could be effective against the virus.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈfaɪndɪŋz səˈdʒɛst ðæt ə nu ˈtritmənt kʊd bi ɪˈfɛktɪv əˈgɛnst ðə ˈvaɪrəs.
examples.translation: Matokeo ya utafiti huonyesha kwamba matibabu mapya yanaweza kuwa yenye faida dhidi ya virusi.
examples.note: Kutumia 'suggest' + 'that' + kipindi cha kusubiri cha kinyume (yanaweza).

examples.original: However, more research is needed to confirm these results.
examples.phonetic: ˌhaʊˈɛvər, mɔr rɪˈsɜrtʃ ɪz ˈnidɪd tu kənˈfɜrm ðiz rɪˈzʌlts.
examples.translation: Lakini, inahitajika utafiti zaidi kuthibitisha matokeo haya.
examples.note: Kushikamana 'however' mwanzo wa jina; katika Kiswahili 'lakini' mara nyingi inatokana na koma.

examples.original: Although vaccines are widely available, some populations still lack access to them.
examples.phonetic: ɔːlˈðoʊ vækˈsinz ɑr ˈwaɪdli əˈveɪləbəl, sʌm ˌpɑpjəˈleɪʃənz stɪl læk ˈæksɛs tu ðɛm.
examples.translation: Ingawa taa zimepatikana kwa kiwango kikubwa, jamii fulani bado hawana uwezo wa kuwepo.
examples.note: Kutumia 'although' kwa ajili ya kutoa, inayofuata na kipindi cha kamilifu, kisha koma.

examples.original: The government must invest more in public health to avoid future pandemics.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈgʌvərnmənt mʌst ɪnˈvɛst mɔr ɪn ˈpʌblɪk hɛlθ tu əˈvɔɪd ˈfjuʧər pænˈdɛmɪks.
examples.translation: Serikali inapaswa kuweka zaidi katika afya ya umma kutoa ugonjwa wa kufikia.
examples.note: Kipindi cha kusudi 'must' kwa ajili ya kusudi kwa nguvu; katika Kiswahili tunatumia 'inapaswa' au 'ina hitajika'.

examples.original: Despite the economic costs, the lockdown was necessary to save lives.
examples.phonetic: dɪˈspaɪt ði ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk kɔsts, ðə ˈlɑkˌdaʊn wʌz ˈnɛsəˌsɛri tu seɪv laɪvz.
examples.translation: Kwa kushindana na gharama za kiuchumi, kufungwa kulikuwa ni lazima kutoa maisha.
examples.note: Utaratibu 'despite + jina' (si kipindi), tofauti na 'although + kipindi'.

translations.sw: Mada ya sayansi na matibabu inayoweza kuelewa

title: Discussing Political and Social Issues / Kutungana masuala ya siasa na jamii
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, tunatumia 'subjunctive mood' baada ya vitenzi kama 'important', 'essential' au 'vital' bila 'that' inayohitajika: 'It's important that we vote'. Togolea nyingine mkubwa: Katika Kihispania, tunatumia subjunctive mood katika vesi vyenye 'cuando' ("Cuando haya elecciones"), lakini Kiingereza hutumia present simple: 'When there are elections'. Heshima kwa kutumia 'should' ambayo wengi kutoka Kihispania hupenda kuweka kwa kutosha katika mifumo hii.
rule: Kwa kushiriki katika mawazo ya siasa na jamii kwenye ngazi ya B2, ni jambo la maana kufahamu: 1) 'Subjunctive mood' baada ya vitenzi vya maana au hitaji (important, essential, vital, necessary): 'It's essential that the government act now'. Surahia ya kiverb ni ya msingi kwa watu wote, bila -s katika mtu wa tatu. 2) Vesi vya muda na 'when', 'if' na masharti: Tunatumia present simple (si siku ijayo) katika vesi isiyokuwa na msingi: 'When the election happens, we'll know the results'. 3) Mashairi ya kushoweka kivuli au kushindana: 'I strongly believe', 'I'm afraid I disagree', 'that's a valid point, but...'. 4) Kutumia 'though' mwisho wa vesi ili kutoa maelezo: 'The policy seems good, though it's expensive'. 5) Togolea ya maneno: 'politics' ni sehemu ya kawaida; 'policy' ni hatua maalum. Katika Kihispania 'política' ina maana mawili, kile kinachofanya kutokea makosa.

concept_examples.text: It's crucial that every citizen vote in the upcoming election.
concept_examples.translation: Ni jambo la maana kwa kila mwananchi kupsua katika uchaguzi unaotoka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪts ˈkruːʃəl ðət ˈɛvri ˈsɪtɪzən voʊt ɪn ði ˌʌpˈkʌmɪŋ ɪˈlɛkʃən/

concept_examples.text: When the government takes action, we will see significant changes.
concept_examples.translation: Wakati serikali itakapoongea hatua, tutaziona mabadiliko makubwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɛn ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt teɪks ˈækʃən wi wɪl si sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz/

concept_examples.text: Many people argue that the new law is unfair, though it has some advantages.
concept_examples.translation: Watu wengi hujaribu kusema sheria mpya ni haki, ingawa ina faida kadhaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ðə nuː lɔː ɪz ʌnˈfɛr ðoʊ ɪt hæz sʌm ədˈvæntɪdʒɪz/

concept_examples.text: It's essential that the media remain impartial during the campaign.
concept_examples.translation: Ni jambo la maana kwa habari kuhifadhi utulivu wakati wa kampeni.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪts ɪˈsɛnʃəl ðət ðə ˈmiːdiə rɪˈmeɪn ɪmˈpɑːrʃəl ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə kæmˈpeɪn/

common_error.wrong: It's important that the government should do something about unemployment.
common_error.correct: It's important that the government do something about unemployment.
common_error.correct_alt: It's important for the government to do something about unemployment.
common_error.explanation: Katika Kihispania, mara nyingi tunaweka 'debería' (should) katika mifumo ya subjunctive: 'Es importante que el gobierno debería hacer algo'. Lakini Kiingereza, baada ya mashairi ya maana, tunatumia subjunctive safi (bila 'should'): kiverb katika sura ya msingi ('do'). Ikiwa unataka kutumia 'should', unahitaji kutumia mifumo tofauti: 'The government should do something', bila 'that'. Badiliko na 'for + infinitive' pia ni sahihi. Hiviwa mifumo mawili.

levels.label: Agreeing and Disagreeing Politely
levels.translation: Kushiriki katika kivuli na kushindana kwa kiwango cha heshima

examples.original: I strongly believe that education should be a priority for every government.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən ʃʊd biː ə praɪˈɔrɪti fɔːr ˈɛvri ˈɡʌvərnmənt/
examples.translation: Nina imani kubwa kwamba elimu inapaswa kuwa jambo la kwanza kwa kila serikali.
examples.note: Tunatumia 'strongly believe' ili kutoa nguvu kwa mawazo. Katika Kihispania husema 'creo firmemente' lakini heshima: usiseme 'I believe strongly' ni kamwe zaidi.

examples.original: That's a valid point, but I'm afraid I have to disagree with you there.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈvælɪd pɔɪnt bʌt aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪ hæv tə ˌdɪsəˈɡriː wɪð juː ðɛr/
examples.translation: Hiyo ni sehemu ya haki, lakini ninahifadhi kwamba ninahitaji kushindana nawe hapa.
examples.note: Katika Kihispania, 'me temo que' hutumia subjunctive: 'me temo que tenga que discrepar'. Kiingereza hutumia indicative: 'I'm afraid I have to'. Usitumie 'I am afraid that I must' (ni rasmi sana).

examples.original: I see what you mean, though I think we should look at the bigger picture.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː wʌt juː miːn ðoʊ aɪ θɪŋk wi ʃʊd lʊk æt ðə ˈbɪɡər ˈpɪktʃər/
examples.translation: Ninawezaje kusema, ingawa ninakiri kwamba tunahitaji kufikiri kuhusu mazingira ya kawaida.
examples.note: 'Though' mwisho wa vesi ni asili sana katika Kiingereza ya kawaida, inavyoelekeza 'aunque' katika Kihispania lakini na amri iliyogeuzwa.

examples.original: If the government invested more in renewable energy, we could reduce pollution significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ɪnˈvɛstɪd mɔːr ɪn rɪˈnuːəbəl ˈɛnərdʒi wi kʊd rɪˈduːs pəˈluːʃən sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Ikiwa serikali ingeweka zaidi katika nishati isiyo na mwisho, tungelimaisha uchafuzi kwa kiwango kikubwa.
examples.note: Katika Kihispania tunatumia subjunctive (invirtiera) na conditional (podríamos). Kiingereza hutumia past simple (invested) na 'could' + infinitive. Usiseme 'If the government would invest' – ni makosa ya kawaida.

examples.original: Unless we address the root causes of inequality, social unrest will continue.
examples.phonetic: /ʌnˈlɛs wi əˈdrɛs ðə ruːt ˈkɔːzɪz əv ˌɪnɪˈkwɑːləti ˈsoʊʃəl ʌnˈrɛst wɪl kənˈtɪnjuː/
examples.translation: Isipokuwa tutashughulikia sababu za msingi za ubaguzi, matatizo ya kijamii yatendeka.
examples.note: Katika Kihispania, 'a menos que' inahitaji subjunctive: 'abordemos'. Kiingereza, tunatumia present simple baada ya 'unless' (ina maana 'if not'). Usitumie siku ijayo: 'Unless we will address'.

examples.original: The rise in unemployment is due to the lack of investment in key industries.
examples.phonetic: /ðə raɪz ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt ɪz duː tə ðə læk əv ɪnˈvɛstmənt ɪn kiː ˈɪndəstriz/
examples.translation: Kuongezeka kwa ajira isipokuwa ni kwa sababu ya ukinguzi wa fedha katika viwanda mkubwa.
examples.note: Katika Kihispania tunatumia 'se debe a'. Kiingereza, 'is due to' ni mifumo isiyoweza kubadilishwa. Usiseme 'is because of' (ingawa inasikilizwa, ni ya kawaida).

examples.original: A direct consequence of the new policy is that small businesses are struggling to survive.
examples.phonetic: /ə dɪˈrɛkt ˈkɒnsɪkwəns əv ðə nuː ˈpɒləsi ɪz ðæt smɔːl ˈbɪznəsɪz ɑːr ˈstrʌɡlɪŋ tə sərˈvaɪv/
examples.translation: Matokeo ya tofauti ya sheria mpya ni kwamba biashara ndogo inapambana kuhifadhi.
examples.note: Katika Kihispania ungsema 'las pequeñas empresas están luchando' – ni karibu sana. Heshima: 'policy' ina maana hatua maalum, si sehemu ya siasa ya kawaida ('politics').

title: Discussing Budgets and Investments / Kuzungumza kuhusu Mapato na Uwekezaji
bridge: Kiingereza, vitendo vya kushughulikia pesa huabadilika kulingana na kama unazungumza kuhusu pesa za kibinadamu au za biashara. Kwa mfano, 'spend' hutumika kwa ajili ya kushughulikia pesa, lakini 'invest' humaana uamuzi wa kistrateji zaidi. Kiswahili, mara nyingi tunatumia 'kuweka' katika mazingira mawili, lakini Kiingereza 'invest' huhifadhiwa kwa kuweka pesa katika kitu cha tumaini la faida. Tofa tofauti nyingine ni kwamba Kiingereza tunatumia mifano ya asili ya asili na vitendo hivi: 'invest in', 'spend on', 'pay for'. Kiswahili, mara nyingi hutoa mfano au hutumia tofauti. Fikiria mifano haya ili kusautiwa kwa asili.
rule: Kuzungumza kuhusu fedha Kiingereza kwenye usawa wa B2, unahitaji kufahamu lugha na mifano. Vitendo vya kawaida: 'earn', 'save', 'spend', 'invest', 'borrow', 'lend', 'owe', 'pay off', 'set aside'. Kila moja una mifano ya asili: 'earn money from', 'save up for', 'spend on', 'invest in', 'borrow from', 'lend to'. Majina: 'budget', 'expenses', 'income', 'savings', 'debt', 'interest rate', 'stock market', 'investment portfolio'. Tumia hali ya sasa kwa ajili ya tabia ('I save 10% of my income'), na hali ya sasa kwa ajili ya matukio ('Have you ever invested in stocks?'). Kwa mashwara, tumia 'should' au 'ought to'. Jikinge na 'lend' vs 'borrow': 'lend' ni kutoa, 'borrow' ni kupokea. Kiswahili, 'kupa' hutoa mawili, lakini Kiingereza ni vitendo tofauti. Pia, 'debt' ni isiyo na kiwango kwa ujumla, lakini 'debts' hutumika kwa ajili ya dayari tofauti. Kumbuka kwamba 'money' ni isiyo na kiwango, usiseme 'moneys'.

concept_examples.text: I need to set aside some money for unexpected expenses.
concept_examples.translation: Ninahitaji kuhifadhi baadhi ya fedha kwa ajili ya matumizi yasiyo na mpango.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛt əˈsaɪd sʌm ˈmʌni fɔːr ˌʌnɪkˈspɛktɪd ɪkˈspɛnsɪz/

concept_examples.text: She invested in a diversified portfolio to reduce risk.
concept_examples.translation: Alieweka fedha katika kifaa cha kuweka kilichojengwa ili kupunguza hatari.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪnˈvɛstɪd ɪn ə daɪˈvɜːsɪfaɪd pɔːrtˈfoʊlioʊ tə rɪˈduːs rɪsk/

concept_examples.text: We're saving up for a down payment on a house.
concept_examples.translation: Tunapata fedha kwa ajili ya malipo ya kwanza ya nyumba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɪər ˈseɪvɪŋ ʌp fɔːr ə daʊn ˈpeɪmənt ɒn ə haʊs/

concept_examples.text: He borrowed money from the bank to start his business.
concept_examples.translation: Alichukua fedha kutoka kwenye benki ili kuanza biashara yake.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈbɒroʊd ˈmʌni frəm ðə bæŋk tə stɑːrt hɪz ˈbɪznəs/

common_error.wrong: I need to invert in a new computer.
common_error.correct: I need to invest in a new computer.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu huhudhuria kwa sababu Kiswahili 'kuweka' hutumika pia kwa ajili ya 'kushughulikia kitu cha maana', lakini Kiingereza 'invest' una maana ya fedha ya kutumaini faida. Ili kushughulikia kitu kama kompyuta, hutumika 'spend on' au 'invest in' kama unakiona kama maendeleo ya kazi. Pia, usawazishaji wa 'invest' (na 'e' fupi) ni tofauti na 'invert' (ambayo maana yake ni kugeuka). Ili kuiepuka makosa, fikiria kama unatumaini faida ya kiuchumi ya baadaye; iwepo la, tumia 'spend'.

examples.original: I try to save 20% of my salary every month.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ traɪ tə seɪv twɛnti pɜːrsɛnt əv maɪ ˈsæləri ˈɛvri mʌnθ/
examples.translation: Ninajikinga kuhifadhi 20% ya malipo yangu kila mwezi.
examples.note: Tumia 'save' + asili + 'of' ili kuelezea kiwango cha kuhifadhi.

examples.original: We spent too much on eating out last week.
examples.phonetic: /wiː spɛnt tuː mʌtʃ ɒn ˈiːtɪŋ aʊt læst wiːk/

title: Kuelezea Mawazo ya Kijamii na Vidokezo / Expresando ideas abstractas y matices
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, tunatumia mifano kama 'it is possible that' au 'I think that' kuelezea vidokezo. Katika Kiingereza, kuelezea maoni au kufikiria kuhusu mustakbal, hutumiwa vitendo vya kiwango na mifano isiyo na mfano ulio wazi. Hitilafu kubwa zaidi ni kutumia subjunctive katika Kiingereza, ambayo haipo, kwa hiyo lazima ujifunze kuelezea shaka au uwezo kwa utendaji wa kiingereza. Pia uwe makini na marafiki wa uongo kama 'actualmente' (actually) au 'realizar' (to realize).
rule:
Kuelezea mawazo ya kijamii katika Kiingereza, ni muhimu kufahamu:
1. Vitendo vya kiwango kwa kufikiria na kufikiria: 'might', 'could', 'may', 'must', 'can't'. Mfano: "She might be right" (Inaweza kuwa na haki) - uwezo huonyeshwa na kiwango, si na subjunctive.
2. Sentensi za kisasa na 'it': "It seems that...", "It is said that...", "It is believed that...". Katika Kihispania hutumiwa 'se dice', 'se cree', katika Kiingereza hutumiwa kisasa cha kisasa.
3. Maneno ya ushahidi: 'apparently', 'presumably', 'totally', 'completely' kuelezea vidokezo.
4. Tofauti kati ya 'actually' (kweli) na 'currently' (sasa). 'Realize' ni 'kujua', si 'realizar'.
5. Kuelezea maoni: 'I would argue that...', 'I tend to think that...', 'From my perspective...'.
6. Makini na kutumia 'suggest' na 'recommend' + that + msingi (bila subjunctive inayonekana): "I suggest that he go" (si 'goes').
7. Kiwango cha 'would' kwa ufikivu: "If I were you, I would..."

concept_examples.text: It might seem counterintuitive, but sometimes failure leads to growth.
concept_examples.translation: Inaweza kuonekana kama haiko na maana, lakini mara nyingi ufiaji huleta uongezaji.

concept_examples.text: I would argue that happiness is not a destination but a way of traveling.
concept_examples.translation: Ningewapigia kilele kwamba furaha si kituo bali njia ya kusafiri.

concept_examples.text: It is widely believed that our perception of reality is shaped by our experiences.
concept_examples.translation: Inaaminiwa kwa kina kwamba utambuzi wetu wa kweli umejengwa na matunzo yetu.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪt ɪz ˈwaɪdli bɪˈliːvd ðæt ˈaʊər pərˈsepʃən əv riˈæləti ɪz ʃeɪpt baɪ ˈaʊər ɪkˈspɪriənsɪz

common_error.wrong: I suggest that he goes to the conference to present his ideas.
common_error.correct: I suggest that he go to the conference to present his ideas.
common_error.correct_alt: I suggest he goes to the conference... (less formal)
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu hii inatokana na kutumia subjunctive au halali ya kihispania. Katika Kiingereza, na vitendo kama 'suggest', 'recommend', 'insist' + that, hutumiwa msingi wa tende (bila 's' katika mtu wa tatu) katika usemi wa kiingereza. Ingawa katika lugha ya kawaida wengi wa asili hutumia halali, katika mazingira ya kijamii au ya kijamii ni bora zaidi kutumia msingi. Ili kuijenga, kumbuka kanuni: 'suggest that + mtu + tende katika msingi'.

examples.original: She might not agree with your interpretation of the theory.
examples.phonetic: ʃiː maɪt nɑːt əˈɡriː wɪð jɔːr ɪnˌtɜːrprɪˈteɪʃən əv ðə ˈθɪəri
examples.translation: Inaweza kuwa hana ufanano na utambuzi wako wa nia ya nia.
examples.note: Tunatumia 'might not' kuelezea uwezo wa kutoa. Katika Kihispania tunaweza kusema 'puede que no'.

examples.original: That can't be the right conclusion; the data contradict it.

examples.translation: Hiyo hii siwezi kuwa jibu la kweli; data inalalamika.
examples.note: 'Can't' huonyesha uhakika kwamba kitu siwezi kuwa. Katika Kihispania tunatumia 'no puede ser'.

examples.original: The author must have intended a different meaning.

examples.translation: Mwandishi alipaswa kuwa na nia ya kutoa maana tofauti.
examples.note: 'Must have + participio' huonyesha ufikivu kuhusu zamani. Katika Kihispania hutumiwa 'debió de' au 'tiene que haber'.

examples.original: It seems that the argument fails to address the core issue.
examples.phonetic: ɪt siːmz ðæt ðə ˈɑːrɡjumənt feɪlz tuː əˈdres ðə kɔːr ˈɪʃuː
examples.translation: Inaonekana kwamba hujaja haifaniki kufikia changamoto kuu.
examples.note: 'It seems that' hutumiwa kama 'parece que' katika Kihispania. Makini na kutoa 'that' katika Kiingereza isiyo rasmi.

examples.original: It is often said that philosophy is the art of asking questions.
examples.phonetic: ɪt ɪz ˈɔːfən sed ðæt fɪˈlɑːsəfi ɪz ði ɑːrt əv ˈæskɪŋ ˈkwestʃənz
examples.translation: Mara nyingi inasemwa kwamba falsafa ni sifa ya kufanya maswali.

examples.original: From my perspective, the ethical dilemma is more complex than it appears.

examples.translation: Kutoka kwenye utazamo wangu, changamoto ya kiethics ni zaidi ya kuwepo kuliko inavyoonekana.
examples.note: 'From my perspective' ni njia ya kutoa maoni. 'Dilemma' ni neno ya Kigiriki, usijaribu na 'dilema' ya Kihispania, lakini ushirika unabadilika.

examples.original: If humanity were to prioritize collective well-being, many conflicts could be avoided.
examples.phonetic: ɪf hjuːˈmænəti wər tuː praɪˈɔːrɪtaɪz kəˈlektɪv wel-ˈbiːɪŋ ˈmeni ˈkɑːnflɪkts kʊd biː əˈvɔɪdɪd
examples.translation: Ikiwa binadamu wangepatia ubora wa kijamii, changamoto nyingi zingelindwa.
examples.note: Kiwango cha 'were to' ni rasmi na hutumiwa kwa ufikivu wa kiwango cha chini. Katika Kihispania hutumiwa subjunctive ya zamani.

examples.original: Should the theory be proven false, we would need to revise our assumptions.
examples.phonetic: ʃʊd ðə ˈθɪəri biː ˈpruːvən fɔːls wi wʊd niːd tuː rɪˈvaɪz ˈaʊər əˈsʌmpʃənz
examples.translation: Ikiwa nia ingekuwa ya uongo, tulikuwa na kuondoa fikra zetu.
examples.note: 'Should + mtu + tende' ni njia ya kuficha 'If...'. Utendaji wa rasmi, wa kawaida katika andiko ya kijamii.

examples.original: Suppose we adopted a utilitarian approach; what would be the consequences?

examples.note: 'Suppose' inayofuata zamani inaonyesha ufikivu. Katika Kihispania hutumiwa 'supongamos que' + subjunctive.

title: Discussing Art and Culture / Kuzungumza juu ya sanaa na utamaduni
bridge: Kwa Kiingereza, tunatumia 'present perfect' (have seen) zaidi kwa ajili ya matukio ya maisha na habari mapya, wakati mwingine tunatumia 'past simple' kwa ajili ya wakati maalum zamani. Jambo lingine ni kwamba kwa Kiingereza, vituo vya maoni (amazing, stunning) huja kabla ya vituo vya maelezo ya kimwili, kama ilivyo Kiingereza, lakini uwe makini na utaratibu wa vituo: kwa Kiingereza husema 'a beautiful old painting' siyo 'an old beautiful painting'. Pia, kwa Kiingereza tunatumia 'the' kusema kuhusu jambo ambalo limetajwa kabla au linajulikana, wakati mwingine kwa Kihispania tunachoka.
rule:
Kuzungumza kuhusu sanaa na utamaduni kwa Kiingereza kwenye ngazi ya B2, unapaswa kufahamu:
- Kutumia 'present simple' kuwasilisha kazi za sanaa: 'The painting depicts...'
- Kutumia 'present perfect' kwa ajili ya matukio: 'I have visited the Prado Museum.'
- Kutumia 'past simple' kwa ajili ya matukio maalum zamani: 'She painted this in 1990.'
- Vituo: utaratibu sahihi (maoni, ukubwa, umri, mifumo, asili) na kutumia 'so' na 'such' kuweka uzuri.
- Maelezo ya maoni: 'In my view...', 'It strikes me as...'
- Mishumo ya kuhakikisha: 'It might be a fake.', 'It could represent freedom.'

concept_examples.text: The painting depicts a woman holding a flower.

concept_examples.text: It's a stunning mix of colors and textures.
concept_examples.translation: Ni mchanganyiko wa rangi na mifumo ambao inaonesha uzuri mkubwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪts ə ˈstʌnɪŋ mɪks əv ˈkʌlərz ənd ˈtɛkstʃərz

common_error.correct_alt: I have seen that painting before.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu ni kutumia 'present perfect' na neno la muda uliopita kama 'jana'. Kwa Kiingereza, unapoelezea muda maalum uliopita, unapaswa kutumia 'past simple'. 'Present perfect' hutumika kwa ajili ya matukio ambayo hawana muda maalum au katika kipindi ambacho bado haikomalika. Ili kuiweka, kumbuka: ukisema 'jana', 'mwaka uliopita', 'mwaka 1990', tumia 'past simple'. Ukitumia 'ever', 'never', 'already', tumia 'present perfect'.

examples.translation: Sanamu hii inaonesha mtu akitembea.
examples.note: Tumia 'represents' kuwasilisha mada wa kazi. Kwa Kihispania, mara nyingi tunatumia 'representa', lakini pia 'es' au 'trata de'.

examples.translation: Kutumia mwanga na giza hutoa athari ya kushangaza.

examples.original: I find the colors in this painting very soothing.

examples.original: That exhibition blew my mind.

examples.note: Mifumo ya 'blow my mind' ni ya kawaida lakini ya kawaida. Kwa Kihispania, 'me voló la cabeza'.

examples.original: The film was so moving that I couldn't hold back tears.

examples.translation: Kile kinachionyesha zaidi ni mada.

examples.translation: Tamasha hii inarudi hadi karne ya 16.

examples.translation: Mtihani umeweka taarifa jipya kuhusu sanaa ya kisasa.

examples.original: If I had more time, I would visit every gallery.

examples.translation: Nikikuwa na muda zaidi, ningeliona galari zote.

examples.original: It's essential that we preserve our cultural heritage.

title: Problem-solving discussions / Majadiliano ya kutatua matatizo
bridge: Kiingereza inatumia ustari wa kishawishi na masharti yanayohusiana, kinyume na Kispanishi kinachotumia subjunctive au jina kama 'podríamos' na '¿qué tal si...?' Kikosi cha kawaida ni kufanya tukio 'si yo sería' badala ya 'if I were' (kishawishi cha pili). Pia, 'should' na 'ought to' hutumika zaidi kuliko 'deberías' katika kutoa ushauri. Fikiria juu ya utaratibu wa vifungu vya kishawishi na kutumia 'would' katika kipengele cha msingi.
rule:
Kutafakari matatizo na kutoa halali katika Kiingereza, utumia ustari huu: 
1. **Kishawishi cha pili** (kihifadhi): 'If + siku iliyopita, would + kitendo cha msingi'. Mifano: 'If we had more time, we could finish the project.' Hutumika katika matukio ya kuhifadhi au yasiyo na uhakika. 
2. **Kishawishi cha tatu** (kihifadhi cha siku iliyopita): 'If + siku iliyopita na kuisha, would have + sehemu'. Mifano: 'If we had known earlier, we would have solved it.' Hutumika katika kuhusu fursa zilizopotea. 
3. **Mishwari ya ushauri**: 'should', 'ought to', 'had better' + kitendo cha msingi. 'Had better' ni nguvu zaidi na ina maana ya matokeo mabaya. 
4. **Sauti za kutoa mawazo**: 'What about...?', 'How about...?', 'Why don't we...?', 'Could we...?', 'Maybe we should...'. 
5. **Sauti za kuweka mikakati**: 'On the one hand... on the other hand...', 'The advantage is...', 'The downside is...', 'It might work because...'. 
6. **Kubaliana na kushindana**: 'I see your point, but...', 'That sounds reasonable, however...', 'I'm not convinced that...'. 
Iepuka kutumia 'would' katika kipengele cha 'if' (kikosi cha kawaida kwa wanaoongea Kispanishi).

common_error.correct: If I had more money, I would buy a new car.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had more money, I could buy a new car.
common_error.explanation: Kikosi hiki kinatokea kwa sababu katika Kispanishi husema 'si yo tendría' (au 'si yo tuviera'), lakini katika Kiingereza, katika kishawishi cha pili, kipengele cha 'if' hutumia siku iliyopita (si 'would'). 'Would' hutumika tu katika kipengele cha msingi. Iepuka kutafsiri kwa ufupi. Kumbuka: 'If + siku iliyopita, would + kitendo'.

examples.original: How about we set a deadline?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt wiː sɛt ə ˈdɛdlaɪn/
examples.translation: Je, tunaweza kuweka mwisho wa muda?
examples.note: Tumia 'How about' + jina + kitendo cha sasa kwa mawazo. Ni zaidi ya kawaida kuliko 'What about'.

examples.original: Maybe we should invest in better software.
examples.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wiː ʃʊd ɪnˈvɛst ɪn ˈbɛtər ˈsɒftwɛər/
examples.translation: Labda tunapaswa kuweka fedha katika programi bora zaidi.
examples.note: 'Should' kwa maswali. Katika B2, unaweza kutumia 'I think we should' kwa kushughulisha.

examples.original: Could we ask for an extension?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd wiː ɑːsk fɔːr ən ɪkˈstɛnʃən/
examples.translation: Je, tunaweza omba mwisho wa muda?
examples.note: 'Could' ni zaidi ya heshima kuliko 'can' kwa mawazo.

examples.original: On one hand, it's cheaper, but on the other hand, it's less reliable.
examples.phonetic: /ɒn wʌn hænd, ɪts ˈtʃiːpər, bʌt ɒn ði ˈʌðər hænd, ɪts lɛs rɪˈlaɪəbl/
examples.translation: Moja kwa moja, ni rahisi zaidi, lakini nyingine, ni adili zaidi.
examples.note: Ustari wa msingi wa kuweka fadhila na matatizo katika majadiliano ya rasmi.

examples.original: The main drawback is that it requires training.
examples.phonetic: /ðə meɪn ˈdrɔːbæk ɪz ðæt ɪt rɪˈkwaɪərz ˈtreɪnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Tatizo kubwa ni kwamba inahitaji mafunzo.
examples.note: 'Drawback' ni jina la 'disadvantage'. Tumia katika mazingira ya biashara.

examples.original: I'm not convinced that this will solve the issue.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm nɒt kənˈvɪnst ðæt ðɪs wɪl sɒlv ði ˈɪʃuː/
examples.translation: Sina uhakika kwamba hii itatatua tatizo.
examples.note: Elezea ubora kwa 'I'm not convinced' + 'that'.

examples.original: If we all agree, we can move forward.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː ɔːl əˈɡriː, wiː kæn muːv ˈfɔːrwərd/
examples.translation: Ikiwa sote tunabali, tunaweza kwenda mbele.
examples.note: Kishawishi cha kwanza kwa matokeo ya kweli. Katika B2, chunguza kishawishi na mishwari ya kitendo.

examples.original: Would you be open to a compromise?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː biː ˈoʊpən tə ə ˈkɒmprəmaɪz/
examples.translation: Je, unaweza kubali kushiriki?
examples.note: Tumia 'would' katika maswali ya heshima kwa kushiriki.

examples.original: I think we need to find a middle ground.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk wiː niːd tə faɪnd ə ˈmɪdl ɡraʊnd/
examples.translation: Nafikiri tunahitaji kupata sehemu ya kati.
examples.note: Sauti ya kienyeji inayotumika sana katika mikusanyiko. 'Middle ground' = sehemu ya kati.

examples.original: So we're all on the same page?
examples.phonetic: /soʊ wɪər ɔːl ɒn ðə seɪm peɪdʒ/
examples.translation: Basi sote tunabali?
examples.note: 'On the same page' maana kubali au kuelewa kile chochote.

title: Talking about Goals and Ambitions / Kuzungumza kuhusu Malengo na Matumaini
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, tunatumia zaidi sentensi za sasa au istahili ya kusudi (kutaka kufanya jambo fulani) kuzungumza kuhusu malengo, lakini katika Kiingereza ni zaidi asili kutumia mifumo kama 'I’m planning to', 'I intend to' au kusudi na 'will' kwa uamuzi wa kawaida. Pia lazima tuwaangalie kwa makini kutumia 'would like' (ningetaka) inayotoa matumaini ya rasmi zaidi au ya kifuatano, jambo ambalo katika Kihispania mara nyingi hufahamika kama 'quiero'. Togolelo lingine mkubwa: katika Kiingereza tunatumia majina ya kusudi (-ing) baada ya mifano na vitendo fulani kama 'look forward to', wakati wa Kihispania tunatumia majina ya kusudi.
rule: Kuzungumza kuhusu malengo na matumaini katika Kiingereza kwa ngazi ya B2, hutumika mifumo mbalimbali: 1) 'be going to + kusudi' kwa mikakati na matumaini yaliyotengenezwa tayari (I’m going to start a business). 2) 'will + kusudi' kwa uamuzi wa kawaida au utabiri (I’ll do my best). 3) 'would like + kusudi' au 'would love + kusudi' kwa matumaini (I’d like to improve my English). 4) Vitendo kama 'hope', 'plan', 'intend', 'expect' zilizofuatawa na kusudi (I hope to travel, I plan to save money). 5) Mifano na majina ya kusudi baada ya mifano: 'look forward to + -ing', 'be interested in + -ing'. 6) Sharti la kwanza kwa malengo yaliyowekwa sharti: 'If I study hard, I’ll pass the exam'. Makosa ya kawaida: kushuka 'to' katika majina ya kusudi, kutumia kusudi baada ya mifano (sahihi: 'I’m good at learning'), na kufafanua 'will' na sasa kuzungumza kuhusu mikakati yaliyotengenezwa tayari. Pia kumbuka kwamba 'hope' inaweza kufuata sasa kwa ajili ya kusudi (I hope I get the job).

concept_examples.text: I’m planning to start my own business next year.
concept_examples.translation: Nina mikakati ya kuanza biashara yangu mwenyewe mwaka ujao.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈplænɪŋ tə stɑːrt maɪ oʊn ˈbɪznəs nekst jɪr/

concept_examples.text: I’d like to improve my public speaking skills.
concept_examples.translation: Ningetaka kuboresha ujuzi wangu wa kuzungumza mbele ya watu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə ɪmˈpruːv maɪ ˈpʌblɪk ˈspiːkɪŋ skɪlz/

concept_examples.text: If I work hard, I’ll achieve my goals.
concept_examples.translation: Ikiwa nitaendelea kufanya vizuri, nitafikia malengo yangu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːrk hɑːrd aɪl əˈtʃiːv maɪ ɡoʊlz/

concept_examples.text: I’m looking forward to graduating from university.
concept_examples.translation: Nina matumaini ya kufikia utamaduni wa chuo kikuu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈɡrædʒueɪtɪŋ frəm ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti/

common_error.wrong: I look forward to graduate from university.
common_error.correct: I look forward to graduating from university.
common_error.correct_alt: I’m looking forward to graduating from university.
common_error.explanation: Makosa hii hutokea kwa sababu katika Kihispania hutumika 'deseando + kusudi' (estoy deseando graduarme). Katika Kiingereza, baada ya mfano 'look forward to', kilele 'to' huhitaji jina la kusudi (-ing), si kusudi. Ni kama kuna kitu cha kufanya kwa watu wanaoongea Kihispania. Kumbuka: kila wakati 'to' ni kilele (si sehemu ya kusudi), inafuata -ing.

examples.original: I’m going to start a new hobby this summer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə stɑːrt ə nuː ˈhɑːbi ðɪs ˈsʌmər/
examples.translation: Nina mikakati ya kuanza shughuli jipya jijini jijini halafu.
examples.note: Hutumiwa 'be going to' kwa mikakati yaliyotengenezwa tayari kabla ya muda wa kuzungumza.

examples.original: I intend to apply for that job in London.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ɪnˈtend tə əˈplaɪ fɔːr ðæt dʒɑːb ɪn ˈlʌndən/
examples.translation: Nina nia ya kutuma maombi ya kazi hiyo nchini London.
examples.note: Kitendo 'intend' kinafuatawa na 'to + kusudi'. Ni zaidi ya rasmi kuliko 'going to'.

examples.original: I’m hoping to save enough money for a trip.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈhoʊpɪŋ tə seɪv ɪˈnʌf ˈmʌni fɔːr ə trɪp/
examples.translation: Nina matumaini ya kuweka fedha nyingi zaidi kwa ajili ya safari.
examples.note: Na 'hope' unaweza kutumia sasa kwa ajili ya kutoa matumaini.

examples.original: I plan to learn Spanish next year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ plæn tə lɜːrn ˈspænɪʃ nekst jɪr/
examples.translation: Nina mikakati ya kujifunza Kihispania mwaka ujao.
examples.note: 'Plan to' inafuatawa na kusudi na hutumika kwa mikakati ya kweli.

examples.original: If I get a promotion, I’ll buy a house.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ɡet ə prəˈmoʊʃən aɪl baɪ ə haʊs/
examples.translation: Ikiwa nitapata kushinda, nitaknunua nyumba.
examples.note: Sharti la kwanza katika Kiingereza: if + sasa, will + kusudi. Hatutumiwa kusudi katika kipindi cha 'if'.

examples.original: Unless I start saving now, I won’t be able to travel.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈles aɪ stɑːrt ˈseɪvɪŋ naʊ aɪ woʊnt bi ˈeɪbəl tə ˈtrævəl/
examples.translation: Ikiwa sitasimama sasa, sitaweza kusafiri.
examples.note: 'Unless' ina maana kama 'kama si' na ina ujumbe wa kutoka, hivyo hatutumiwa 'not' katika kipindi hicho.

examples.original: Provided that I finish my thesis, I’ll graduate in June.
examples.phonetic: /prəˈvaɪdɪd ðæt aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ maɪ ˈθiːsɪs aɪl ˈɡrædʒueɪt ɪn dʒuːn/
examples.translation: Ikiwa nitakomaliza ujumbe wangu, nitapata utamaduni wa chuo kikuu mwezi wa Juni.
examples.note: 'Provided that' ni zaidi ya rasmi kuliko 'if' na maana yake ni 'kama'.

examples.original: Once I have enough experience, I’ll start my own company.
examples.phonetic: /wʌns aɪ hæv ɪˈnʌf ɪkˈspɪriəns aɪl stɑːrt maɪ oʊn ˈkʌmpəni/
examples.translation: Baada ya kupata ujuzi mwakilishi, nitakua na biashara yangu mwenyewe.
examples.note: Hutumiwa 'once' + sasa kwa ajili ya kusudi, ina maana kama 'wakati'.

examples.original: I would love to become a successful writer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd lʌv tə bɪˈkʌm ə səkˈsesfəl ˈraɪtər/
examples.translation: Ningetaka sana kuwa mwanamuziki wenye mafanikio.
examples.note: 'Would love to' ni zaidi ya kutoa matumaini kuliko 'would like to' na hutumika kwa matumaini makubwa.

examples.original: My dream is to travel around the world and help communities.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ driːm ɪz tə ˈtrævəl əˈraʊnd ðə wɜːrld ənd help kəˈmjuːnətiz/
examples.translation: Ndoto yangu ni kusafiri duniani na kusaidia jamii.
examples.note: Wakati ndoto ni mwadilishi, hutumika 'is to + kusudi' kutoa malengo.

examples.original: I’m working towards becoming a certified coach.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈwɜːrkɪŋ təˈwɔːrdz bɪˈkʌmɪŋ ə ˈsɜːrtɪfaɪd koʊtʃ/
examples.translation: Ninafanya kazi ili kuwa mwanamuziki wenye usafi.
examples.note: Mfano 'work towards' inafuatawa na jina la kusudi kwa sababu 'towards' ni kilele.

examples.original: In ten years’ time, I hope to have my own practice.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn ten jɪrz taɪm aɪ hoʊp tə hæv maɪ oʊn ˈpræktɪs/
examples.translation: Ndani ya miaka kumi, nina matumaini ya kuwa na ofisi yangu mwenyewe.
examples.note: Hutumiwa 'in + kipindi + muda' kuzungumza kuhusu muda wa kusudi.
